maker: Fireworks AI (draft model built on Alibaba's Qwen3-1.7B)

details.description: qwen3-1p7b-fp8-draft-131072 is Fireworks AI's fp8-quantized draft model, built on Alibaba Qwen's dense 1.7-billion-parameter Qwen3-1.7B, for use as the small proposer model in speculative decoding alongside a larger model. Fireworks' listing describes it as tuned for a 131,072-token context length and states it is a base model, not a standalone chat model: quality is traded for fast, cheap token proposals. It is available for on-demand deployment on dedicated GPUs with LoRA fine-tuning, but not through Fireworks' serverless deployment.
advantages: Fireworks fp8-quantizes the model specifically for use as a draft model, per its listing.
Supports LoRA fine-tuning for customization, per its Fireworks listing.
Available for on-demand deployment on dedicated GPUs, per its Fireworks listing.
disadvantages: Function calling is not supported, per its Fireworks listing.
Not available through Fireworks' serverless deployment, only on-demand, per its listing.
As a draft model it is built for fast token proposals rather than standalone response quality.
use_cases: Speculative decoding to accelerate inference of a larger Qwen3 model at up to 131,072 tokens of context.

notes: This is a Fireworks-specific speculative-decoding draft artifact, not a model Qwen itself publishes under this name; description of the base architecture (dense, 1.7B params, Apache 2.0) comes from Qwen's own Qwen3-1.7B card. No benchmark scores were found for the draft variant itself, so evaluations is empty.
